subject: Hospitality
title: Ian Schrager: The Boutique Hotel Inventor
description: A short lesson to help you apply Ian Schrager: The Boutique Hotel Inventor.

hook.text: Ian Schrager co-owned Studio 54—New York's legendary nightclub. Then he reinvented the hotel industry with Morgans Hotel.

buildup.text: Morgans (1984) was small, design-forward, and personality-driven. No two rooms were identical. It felt like staying in art.

discovery.text: Schrager coined the concept: 'boutique hotel.' Small, unique, design-led properties that rejected the sameness of big chains.

twist.text: Chain hotels eventually co-opted the boutique concept. Marriott's Autograph Collection is effectively corporate boutique.

climax.text: Schrager later created PUBLIC hotels—design-driven but affordable. He democratized the very concept he had made exclusive.

punchline.text: Nightclub impresario to hotel inventor. Schrager made hotels exciting again.

quiz.question: What was Ian Schrager's key innovation in hotels?
options: The boutique hotel concept—small, design-led, personality-driven properties
